decisions.reason: Heavy investment, a dedicated page and public government references to the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes make this product central to the firm's aviation direction, so management keeps it.
Post-pandemic demand keeps fading and nothing new has been reported, but the dedicated page and its fit with the travel data suite let management still treat the weakness as temporary.
The module is cheap to keep and sits close to the certified training business, though it has little visible commitment beyond a passing mention.
Development effort already spent and its link to the firm's long-standing aviation security expertise justify persisting, although dropping the related behaviour analysis system raises some doubt.
The dedicated page signals public commitment, and the platform is closely tied to the firm's core document verification capabilities, so management holds on to it.
